facts.fact: RISA's CTO told The New Times that Rwanda is establishing a national data sharing platform, to be built in phases from requirements and design through core platform development integrated with pilot systems, with launch of a fully operational portal planned for 2026 and a firm still to be onboarded.

The New Times reports that, according to RISA, the Shared Government Data Hub and a Data Interoperability Platform are being worked on, with the Data Hub moving into implementation.

facts.fact: Annex 7 to the National Data Sharing Policy, issued by the Ministry of ICT and Innovation, says an accredited provider such as RISA will develop and implement a data sharing platform between government entities, possibly based on the Government Enterprise Services Bus or an API gateway.

The government told the World Bank's GovTech survey (2025) that its Government Enterprise Service Bus (GESB) is a government service bus platform in use, dated 2023 by the survey and linked to the platform's own site.

note: In service already held as RWA-009.

facts.fact: The deck says some systems are already integrated with the government enterprise service bus, which the social registry uses to share data with NIDA, CRVS, RRA, LAND, SDMS, LODA and RSSB systems, with Kafka for real-time streaming.
